_governed_artifacts: Artifacts in the group that this pin speaks for. org.pragmatica-lite:jbct-maven-plugin is at 0.4.6 and releases on its own line, so comparing it against core's pin would demand a wrong edit forever; it carries not-core inventory entries instead.

upstream._: The external fact the old constant was never compared against. <release> is what Maven Central last published. Read 2026-09-09: 1.0.0-rc3, lastUpdated 20260902212949. The highest tag at github.com/pragmaticalabs/pragmatica is v1.0.0-rc3, so the two independent external sources agree; pragmatica HEAD sits on branch release-1.0.0-rc4 with no rc4 tag published.

known_behind.why: Central published rc3 on 2026-09-02 and this repository still declares rc1. Which value the books should assert is the owner's ruling, not this PR's: bumping the pin re-asserts every dependency snippet and both chapter headers against a library nobody has re-read them against. Delete this key when the pin moves — with it gone the check fails until declaration and Central agree.

known_versions._: Every version org.pragmatica-lite:core has published, read from maven_metadata on 2026-09-09 (38 entries). It bounds the safety net: an UNATTRIBUTED literal is only worth a human's classification when Pragmatica has really shipped that version. Without it the check demands entries for all 111 book versions, POM model versions and URL fragments in the tree, and an inventory that size gets routed around rather than maintained. Refresh it in the same PR that moves the pin — note that plain 1.0.0 is NOT yet a published version, so a GA release must add it here.

space._: Subtracted from `git ls-files`. Every glob here is a dated record whose job is to name old versions. Anything else removed from the search must be argued for in writing, because a narrowed space was defect (b) of the check this replaces.

render_exceptions.why: The two coordinate forms on line 5 (org.pragmatica-lite:core and org.pragmatica-lite.aether:*). Paired with the mechanical-deferred inventory entry for the same file: the site agrees with Maven Central and the declaration does not, and the owner rules which moves. The page is NOT converted to {{PRAGMATICA_VERSION}} in this PR, because substituting it today would render rc1 and make the site LESS correct than it is now — the conversion is one edit, gated on the ruling.

_render_exceptions: Read by website/build.js only, which guards the site's own voice (website/content/*.md) by coordinate form. The repository-wide check is ai-tools/pragmatica-pins.py; these two lists are separate because they answer different questions and the build must not depend on python3.

inventory.why: The site states rc3 while this repository declares rc1; the site is the surface that agrees with Maven Central. Four occurrences on one line: the prose version, the core coordinate, the aether wildcard coordinate, and the GitHub release tag. Deferred, not edited, because the owner rules which value is canonical. SEPARATELY UNRESOLVED and NOT settled by this entry: whether `org.pragmatica-lite.aether:*` is a true wildcard. Two attempts to check it used unsound instruments (probing module names absent at the tag; an artifactId extraction disagreeing with git ls-tree). Deriving that line mechanically would freeze an unverified claim, so build.js substitutes the VERSION only.
